versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Anubis Lite – Career Application Engine.
- Instantly analyzes pasted job descriptions and extracts key ATS technical and soft skill keywords.
- Detects role title and years of experience requirements from job posting.
- Generates an ATS keyword report and 5 tailored, quantifiable resume bullet points.
- Provides a quick, role-specific positioning statement for resumes.
- Includes feature comparison and upgrade path to Anubis Standard and Pro versions.
